ruleDefinitions.name: ESXi Network Configuration Discovery Via ESXCLI
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects execution of the "esxcli" command with the "network" flag in order to retrieve information about the network configuration.

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\/esxcli$") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*network.*")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ get.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ list.*")))
